Account.title: Account
Account.description: db/schema.lite — the seed.  This file is the only place any of the following is written down. Everything the example does with it is derived, at build time or at runtime:  the tables               ← autoMigrate(db) CRUD + pagination        ← createService({}) reads the model 401 / 403                ← @@gate, via junction's derived gateAuth hook 400 on bad input         ← the field rules, via junction's autoValidate hook make() defaults          ← generateJsonSchema → registerSchemas → the browser fields / enum options    ← the same document, $ref resolved client-side client-side validation   ← the same rules again, checked before the request relation pickers         ← x-relations which buttons to render  ← x-gate  Model names are PascalCase and singular — ALWAYS.

slug.description: Nullable AND unique — the case that makes blankToNull matter. An empty text box submits '', SQLite accepts any number of NULLs but rejects a second '', so without normalization the second lead saved with an empty slug fails a constraint nobody wrote.

notes.description: Nullable — `WHERE notes IS NULL` should find leads with no notes, which it does not if the UI stores '' instead.

accountId.description: belongsTo. `accountId` is emitted as a plain integer, so the browser only knows it is a reference because x-relations says so — that is what turns it into a picker instead of a number spinner.
